Graviert jede Zeile abwechselnd hin und: Engraves alternate lines back and forth instead of always in the same direction – almost twice as fast; edges may be slightly offset (calibrate the shift on the device).
Beginnt mit der untersten Zeile statt de: Starts with the bottom line instead of the top one. Depending on where the exhaust is, smoke then does not drift over areas already engraved.

Ab dem ersten Pfad jeweils der nächstgel: From the first path always on to the nearest one, regardless of inner contours (VisiCut “Nearest”); parts may drop out before their holes are cut.
Kleinste Pfade zuerst, gemessen an der F: Smallest paths first, measured by the area of the bounding box (VisiCut “Smallest first”).

Gravur mit {dpi} DPI: Nur 500 DPI ist am: Engraving at {dpi} DPI: only 500 DPI has been tested on the device; supervise the first job

Bedingungen (Farbe, Linienstärke, Ebene,: Adjust the conditions (colour, stroke width, layer, type, ID) in the steps; “Rest” takes all remaining objects. Template, ignore rules and colour tolerance: Settings → Job.
Farbregeln erfassen auch Farben mit fast: Colour rules also catch colours with almost the same hue, e.g. #ed1c24 as red, #00a651 as green and #2e3192 as blue after a CMYK to RGB conversion; greys by brightness.

Gleicht Wabe, Lamellen und Kratzer aus;: Evens out honeycomb, slats and scratches; larger values round off corners.

Für Illustrator CS5.1 oder neuer: schick: For Illustrator CS5.1 or later: sends the drawing or the selection to VisiCutR as a part.
